l1.text: Welcome to the Nonantum Capital Partners annual meeting. Here's our update on the portfolio, year to date.

l2.text: Since twenty eighteen, our partners have committed about one billion dollars across two funds, backing founder-owned businesses, corporate carve-outs, and complex situations.

l3.text: Today that's twelve platform investments, across consumer, industrials, and business services.

l4.text: Twenty twenty-six has been active. We welcomed Flatiron Search Partners in January, and RoadOne added Higgins Transport at the Port of Charleston.

l5.text: Across the portfolio, revenue is up fourteen percent year to date, and EBITDA is up seventeen, with nine add-on acquisitions closed.

l6.text: Fund One stands at two point one times invested capital, and Fund Two at one point four.

l7.text: One standout: Lifted Trucks has sold more than six thousand four hundred trucks this year, up thirty-seven percent, and opened five new stores.

l8.text: For the rest of the year, we're focused on add-ons, cash conversion, and preparing Fund One for realizations.

l9.text: Thank you for your continued partnership.
